propositions: Three independent code paths (review_kernel/verify.py, completion.py, code-review.yaml) for selecting verifier models each have broken equality comparisons that silently revert to the frontier model when a non-default provider is configured.

The equality test (cfg.model == DEFAULT_MODEL) incorrectly treats provider-qualified model IDs (e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-4-8) as explicit operator overrides, causing verifier downgrades to fail silently.
code-review.yaml's verify step declares no model key and carries temperature:0 for determinism, so it falls through to cfg.model (frontier) and the temperature setting never takes effect.

All three verifier paths must call a single resolve_model_string() function to recognize reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) and resolve them through load_class_slots(), while passing literal model IDs through unchanged.

The resolution mechanism cannot be centralized in config.resolve_model due to a circular dependency (model_classes imports config at module level), so separate call sites must each invoke resolve_model_string() to resolve reserved class names.
